title.en: Unit 7 Notes — Axially Loaded Short Column and Isolated Footing

h.en: 7.1 Column types, slenderness and minimum eccentricity
h.gu: 7.1 Column ના પ્રકારો, slenderness અને minimum eccentricity

body.en:
Column classification:

  • A short column has both effective-length-to-lateral-dimension ratios below 12 under IS 456; otherwise slender-column effects require consideration.
  • Axially loaded, uniaxially loaded and biaxially loaded columns differ by whether bending acts about neither, one or both axes in the analysis model.
  • Actual column loading is never assumed perfectly concentric for design: check minimum eccentricity about each axis.
  • Effective length depends on end restraint, frame bracing and code tables; it is not always the unsupported length.

Minimum eccentricity in a direction is emin = l/500 + lateral dimension/30, subject to a minimum of 20 mm, where l is unsupported length for this provision. Use the correct dimensions and effective lengths for both directions. Where applicable IS 456 clause 39.3 permits the simplified axially loaded short tied-column formula only when minimum eccentricity does not exceed 0.05 times the relevant lateral dimension; other cases need the appropriate combined axial load and bending design.
body.gu:
Column classification:

  • IS 456 મુજબ short column માટે બંને effective-length-to-lateral-dimension ratios 12 કરતાં ઓછા છે; અન્યથા slender-column effects ધ્યાનમાં લેવા પડે છે.
  • Axially loaded, uniaxially loaded અને biaxially loaded columns માં analysis model મુજબ અનુક્રમે કોઈ નહીં, એક અથવા બંને axes વિશે bending છે.
  • Design માં actual column loading ને સંપૂર્ણ concentric માની શકાતું નથી: દરેક axis માટે minimum eccentricity તપાસો.
  • Effective length end restraint, frame bracing અને code tables પર આધારિત છે; તે હંમેશા unsupported length નથી.

દિશા પ્રમાણે minimum eccentricity emin = l/500 + lateral dimension/30 છે, ઓછામાં ઓછું 20 mm; આ provision માં l unsupported length છે. બંને દિશા માટે યોગ્ય dimensions અને effective lengths લો. લાગુ હોય ત્યારે IS 456 clause 39.3 મુજબ simplified axially loaded short tied-column formula ફક્ત minimum eccentricity સંબંધિત lateral dimension ના 0.05 કરતાં વધુ ન હોય ત્યારે વાપરો; અન્ય કેસમાં યોગ્ય combined axial load અને bending design જરૂરી છે.

h.en: 7.2 Short tied columns: strength and detailing
h.gu: 7.2 Short tied columns: strength અને detailing

body.en:
For the qualifying short tied column under the code’s minimum eccentricity condition, Pu = 0.4fck Ac + 0.67fy Asc, with Ac = Ag − Asc. It is a design resistance for a specified condition, not a general interaction formula for an arbitrary axial load and moment. Take factored load Pu from appropriate combinations and compare with resistance.

Key detailing provisions:

  • Longitudinal steel is normally 0.8% to 6% of gross area; the code and practical lap congestion should be checked.
  • At least four longitudinal bars for rectangular columns, minimum six for circular columns; minimum longitudinal bar diameter 12 mm.
  • Lateral tie diameter at least 6 mm and at least one-quarter of largest longitudinal bar diameter.
  • Tie pitch not more than the least of least lateral dimension, 16 times smallest longitudinal bar diameter and 300 mm. Ensure corner and intermediate bar restraint per code.
  • Nominal cover depends on column dimensions, exposure and fire provisions; seismic detailing may impose additional rules.

The syllabus covers ties only; helical reinforcement is outside this unit.
body.gu:
Code ની minimum eccentricity condition સંતોષતા short tied column માટે Pu = 0.4fck Ac + 0.67fy Asc છે, જ્યાં Ac = Ag − Asc. આ નિર્દિષ્ટ condition માટે design resistance છે; મનસ્વી axial load અને moment માટે general interaction formula નથી. યોગ્ય combinations થી factored load Pu લઈ resistance સાથે સરખાવો.

મુખ્ય detailing provisions:

  • Longitudinal steel સામાન્ય રીતે gross area નું 0.8% થી 6% છે; code અને lap સમયે વ્યવહારુ congestion તપાસો.
  • Rectangular columns માટે ઓછામાં ઓછા ચાર longitudinal bars અને circular columns માટે છ bars; minimum longitudinal bar diameter 12 mm.
  • Lateral tie diameter ઓછામાં ઓછું 6 mm અને સૌથી મોટા longitudinal bar diameter ના એક-ચતુર્થાંશ જેટલું હોવું જોઈએ.
  • Tie pitch, least lateral dimension, સૌથી નાના longitudinal bar diameter ના 16 ગણા અને 300 mm માંથી ઓછાથી વધુ નહીં. Corner અને intermediate bars ને code મુજબ restraint આપો.
  • Nominal cover column dimensions, exposure અને fire provisions પર આધારિત છે; seismic detailing માં વધારાના rules હોઈ શકે.

Syllabus માં ફક્ત ties છે; helical reinforcement આ unit બહાર છે.

h.en: 7.3 Isolated footing: types and soil pressure
h.gu: 7.3 Isolated footing: પ્રકારો અને soil pressure

body.en:
Types and applications:

  • A pad footing has uniform thickness and spreads a column load over soil.
  • A sloped footing tapers away from the column, reducing concrete where smaller depth is adequate.
  • Square or rectangular plan depends on column load, property boundaries, soil and available space.

Size the plan using service loads and the geotechnical allowable soil bearing pressure on a consistent gross or net basis. Include footing weight, soil overburden and buoyancy as applicable; check settlement, groundwater, eccentricity and uplift. Use factored soil pressure for structural ultimate checks, not the service allowable pressure. A uniform pressure assumption requires a suitably concentric load and compatible soil model.
body.gu:
પ્રકારો અને ઉપયોગ:

  • Pad footing ની thickness સમાન હોય છે અને તે column load ને soil પર ફેલાવે છે.
  • Sloped footing column થી દૂર taper થાય છે જેથી ઓછી depth પૂરતી હોય ત્યાં concrete ઓછું થાય છે.
  • Square અથવા rectangular plan, column load, property boundaries, soil અને ઉપલબ્ધ જગ્યા પ્રમાણે નક્કી થાય છે.

Service loads અને geotechnical allowable soil bearing pressure નો સુસંગત gross અથવા net basis લઈને plan size નક્કી કરો. લાગુ હોય ત્યાં footing weight, soil overburden અને buoyancy ઉમેરો; settlement, groundwater, eccentricity અને uplift તપાસો. Structural ultimate checks માટે factored soil pressure લો, service allowable pressure નહીં. Uniform pressure માટે યોગ્ય concentric load અને compatible soil model જરૂરી છે.

items.syllabus_item: 7.6 bending one way two way shear development

body.en:
Design and check sequence:

  1. Establish service loads and soil capacity; select plan dimensions and trial thickness. Obtain factored soil pressure from factored actions.
  2. For a concentric rectangular footing with uniform upward pressure, calculate bending at the column face in both directions; a projection acts as a cantilever. Design bottom reinforcement in each direction using the actual effective depth.
  3. Check one-way shear at a section one effective depth d from the column face, using the applicable concrete shear strength and provisions.
  4. Check two-way punching at the critical perimeter d/2 from column face. Deduct the upward pressure within the perimeter from factored column force when determining net punching shear; use actual perimeter, effective depth and applicable IS 456 resistance.
  5. Check development length from critical sections, column load transfer, dowel anchorage, bearing, cover, minimum steel and bar distribution. Rectangular footing short-direction distribution has special provisions.
  6. Revise thickness, dimensions or steel and repeat as needed. A sloped footing needs checks at appropriate sections using actual varying depth.

For interior concentric punching, τv = Vu/(b0d); IS 456 punching resistance uses ks × 0.25√fck with ks = min(0.5 + βc, 1), where βc is the shorter-to-longer column side ratio. Verify the applicable conditions and code clauses.
body.gu:
Design અને check sequence:

  1. Service loads અને soil capacity નક્કી કરો; plan dimensions તથા trial thickness પસંદ કરો. Factored actions થી factored soil pressure મેળવો.
  2. Concentric rectangular footing પર uniform upward pressure માટે બંને દિશામાં column face પર bending ગણો; projection cantilever જેવું કાર્ય કરે છે. દરેક દિશામાં actual effective depth થી bottom reinforcement design કરો.
  3. Column face થી એક effective depth d દૂરના section પર લાગુ concrete shear strength અને provisions વડે one-way shear તપાસો.
  4. Column face થી d/2 દૂરના critical perimeter પર two-way punching તપાસો. Net punching shear શોધતી વખતે factored column force માંથી perimeter ની અંદરનું upward pressure બાદ કરો; actual perimeter, effective depth અને લાગુ IS 456 resistance વાપરો.
  5. Critical sections થી development length, column load transfer, dowel anchorage, bearing, cover, minimum steel અને bar distribution તપાસો. Rectangular footing માં short-direction distribution માટે special provisions છે.
  6. જરૂર પ્રમાણે thickness, dimensions અથવા steel સુધારી ફરી તપાસો. Sloped footing માટે actual બદલાતી depth સાથે યોગ્ય sections પર checks જરૂરી છે.

Interior concentric punching માટે τv = Vu/(b0d) છે; IS 456 punching resistance માં ks × 0.25√fck છે, જ્યાં ks = min(0.5 + βc, 1) અને βc column ની short-to-long side ratio છે. લાગુ conditions અને code clauses તપાસો.

title.gu: Numerical 7.1 — Short tied-column strength ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A tied M20/Fe415 column is 400 mm square with 4 bars of 22 mm diameter. Unsupported and effective lengths about both axes are 3 m. Find approximate axial design strength if the simplified IS 456 conditions apply.

Step 1. Check slenderness and minimum eccentricity.

Le / D = 3000 / 400Le / D = 7.5 < 12emin = max(3000 / 500 + 400 / 30, 20)emin = max(19.33, 20)emin = 20 mm0.05D = 0.05 × 4000.05D = 20 mm

Step 2. Find steel and concrete areas.

Ag = 400 × 400Ag = 160000 mm²Asc = 4 × π × 22² / 4Asc ≈ 1520.53 mm²Ac = 160000 − 1520.53Ac ≈ 158479.47 mm²Steel percentage = 100 × 1520.53 / 160000Steel percentage ≈ 0.95%

Step 3. Calculate design resistance.

Pu,R = 0.4fck Ac + 0.67fy AscPu,R = 0.4 × 20 × 158479.47 + 0.67 × 415 × 1520.53Pu,R ≈ 1690619 N

Final answer:

Axial design resistance ≈ 1690.62 kN under the stated conditions; actual moments, load combinations, cover and tie detailing must be checked.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Tied M20/Fe415 column 400 mm square છે અને તેમાં 22 mm diameter ના 4 bars છે. બંને axes માટે unsupported અને effective lengths 3 m છે. Simplified IS 456 conditions લાગુ હોય તો અંદાજિત axial design strength શોધો.

Step 1. Slenderness અને minimum eccentricity તપાસો.

Le / D = 3000 / 400Le / D = 7.5 < 12emin = max(3000 / 500 + 400 / 30, 20)emin = max(19.33, 20)emin = 20 mm0.05D = 0.05 × 4000.05D = 20 mm

Step 2. Steel અને concrete areas શોધો.

Ag = 400 × 400Ag = 160000 mm²Asc = 4 × π × 22² / 4Asc ≈ 1520.53 mm²Ac = 160000 − 1520.53Ac ≈ 158479.47 mm²Steel percentage = 100 × 1520.53 / 160000Steel percentage ≈ 0.95%

Step 3. Design resistance ગણો.

Pu,R = 0.4fck Ac + 0.67fy AscPu,R = 0.4 × 20 × 158479.47 + 0.67 × 415 × 1520.53Pu,R ≈ 1690619 N

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ conditions હેઠળ axial design resistance ≈ 1690.62 kN; actual moments, load combinations, cover અને tie detailing તપાસવાં જરૂરી છે.

title.en: Numerical 7.2 — Square isolated footing: preliminary structural checks
title.gu: Numerical 7.2 — Square isolated footing: preliminary structural checks ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A concentric 400 mm square column transfers 400 kN service load. A 2 m square, 425 mm thick M20 footing and uniformly distributed overburden together weigh 50 kN. Gross allowable bearing pressure is 150 kN/m². Use factor 1.5 for all loads, conservative effective depth d = 350 mm, Fe415 steel, and verified conservative τc = 0.25 MPa. Assume nominal cover 50 mm and 12 mm bars at 150 mm both ways.

Step 1. Check gross service soil pressure.

A = 2 × 2A = 4 m²qservice = (400 + 50) / 4qservice = 112.5 kN/m²112.5 < 150 kN/m²

Step 2. Find net factored upward pressure for structural action.

qu,gross = 1.5 × 112.5qu,gross = 168.75 kN/m²Factored footing and overburden pressure = 1.5 × 50 / 4Factored footing and overburden pressure = 18.75 kN/m²qu,net = 168.75 − 18.75qu,net = 150 kN/m²

Step 3. Check moment and provided flexural steel per metre.

Projection a = (2 − 0.4) / 2a = 0.8 mMu = qu,net a² / 2Mu = 150 × 0.8² / 2Mu = 48 kN m/mAst = π × 12² / 4 × 1000 / 150Ast ≈ 753.98 mm²/mAst,min = 0.0012 × 1000 × 425Ast,min = 510 mm²/mxu = 0.87 × 415 × 753.98 / (0.36 × 20 × 1000)xu ≈ 37.81 mmxu,max = 0.48 × 350xu,max = 168 mmMu,R = 0.87 × 415 × 753.98 × (350 − 0.42 × 37.81) / 10⁶Mu,R ≈ 90.96 kN m/m

Step 4. Check one-way shear one d from the face.

Vu = 150 × (0.8 − 0.35)Vu = 67.50 kN/mτv = 67500 / (1000 × 350)τv ≈ 0.193 MPaτv < τc = 0.25 MPa

Step 5. Check punching at d/2 from the column face.

Critical side = 0.4 + 0.35Critical side = 0.75 mb0 = 4 × 0.75b0 = 3.0 mVu,punch = 1.5 × 400 − 150 × 0.75²Vu,punch = 515.625 kNτv,punch = 515625 / (3000 × 350)τv,punch ≈ 0.491 MPaks = min(0.5 + 1.0, 1)ks = 1τc,punch = ks × 0.25√20τc,punch ≈ 1.118 MPa

Step 6. Check a basic straight anchorage length.

Ld = 12 × 0.87 × 415 / (4 × 1.92)Ld ≈ 564.14 mmAvailable straight length from face ≈ 800 − 50Available straight length ≈ 750 mm

Final answer:

Illustrated bearing, flexure, one-way shear, punching and straight anchorage checks pass. Confirm actual bar depths, cover, soil settlement, column load transfer, development at every critical section and detailing before any design use.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Concentric 400 mm square column, 400 kN service load આપે છે. 2 m square, 425 mm જાડા M20 footing અને uniformly distributed overburden નો કુલ વજન 50 kN છે. Gross allowable bearing pressure 150 kN/m² છે. બધા loads માટે factor 1.5, conservative effective depth d = 350 mm, Fe415 steel અને verified conservative τc = 0.25 MPa લો. Nominal cover 50 mm તથા બંને દિશામાં 12 mm bars at 150 mm ધારો.

Step 1. Gross service soil pressure તપાસો.

A = 2 × 2A = 4 m²qservice = (400 + 50) / 4qservice = 112.5 kN/m²112.5 < 150 kN/m²

Step 2. Structural action માટે net factored upward pressure શોધો.

qu,gross = 1.5 × 112.5qu,gross = 168.75 kN/m²Factored footing and overburden pressure = 1.5 × 50 / 4Factored footing and overburden pressure = 18.75 kN/m²qu,net = 168.75 − 18.75qu,net = 150 kN/m²

Step 3. Metre દીઠ moment અને આપેલ flexural steel તપાસો.

Projection a = (2 − 0.4) / 2a = 0.8 mMu = qu,net a² / 2Mu = 150 × 0.8² / 2Mu = 48 kN m/mAst = π × 12² / 4 × 1000 / 150Ast ≈ 753.98 mm²/mAst,min = 0.0012 × 1000 × 425Ast,min = 510 mm²/mxu = 0.87 × 415 × 753.98 / (0.36 × 20 × 1000)xu ≈ 37.81 mmxu,max = 0.48 × 350xu,max = 168 mmMu,R = 0.87 × 415 × 753.98 × (350 − 0.42 × 37.81) / 10⁶Mu,R ≈ 90.96 kN m/m

Step 4. Face થી એક d દૂર one-way shear તપાસો.

Vu = 150 × (0.8 − 0.35)Vu = 67.50 kN/mτv = 67500 / (1000 × 350)τv ≈ 0.193 MPaτv < τc = 0.25 MPa

Step 5. Column face થી d/2 દૂર punching તપાસો.

Critical side = 0.4 + 0.35Critical side = 0.75 mb0 = 4 × 0.75b0 = 3.0 mVu,punch = 1.5 × 400 − 150 × 0.75²Vu,punch = 515.625 kNτv,punch = 515625 / (3000 × 350)τv,punch ≈ 0.491 MPaks = min(0.5 + 1.0, 1)ks = 1τc,punch = ks × 0.25√20τc,punch ≈ 1.118 MPa

Step 6. Basic straight anchorage length તપાસો.

Ld = 12 × 0.87 × 415 / (4 × 1.92)Ld ≈ 564.14 mmAvailable straight length from face ≈ 800 − 50Available straight length ≈ 750 mm

અંતિમ જવાબ:

દર્શાવેલ bearing, flexure, one-way shear, punching અને straight anchorage checks સંતોષાય છે. કોઈ design ઉપયોગ પહેલાં actual bar depths, cover, soil settlement, column load transfer, દરેક critical section પર development અને detailing તપાસો.

q.gu: Short column શું છે?

a.en: A column meeting the code slenderness limits in both directions.
a.gu: બંને દિશામાં code slenderness limits સંતોષતો column.

q.gu: Minimum eccentricity શું છે?

a.en: The minimum offset required by the code for column design.
a.gu: Column design માટે code મુજબ minimum offset.

q.gu: Effective length શું છે?

a.en: Equivalent length reflecting end restraint and stability.
a.gu: End restraint અને stability દર્શાવતી equivalent length.

q.gu: Tied column શું છે?

a.en: A column with longitudinal bars restrained by lateral ties.
a.gu: Lateral ties વડે restrained longitudinal bars ધરાવતો column.

q.en: Minimum bars in a rectangular column?
q.gu: Rectangular column માં minimum bars કેટલા?
Lateral ties કેમ આપવામાં આવે?

a.en: To restrain longitudinal bars and hold the cage.
a.gu: Longitudinal bars ને restrain કરવા અને cage જાળવવા.

q.gu: Isolated footing શું છે?

a.en: A footing supporting an individual column or concentrated load.
a.gu: એક column અથવા concentrated load ને support આપતું footing.

q.gu: Pad footing શું છે?

a.en: An isolated footing of uniform thickness.

q.gu: Sloped footing શું છે?

a.en: A footing whose depth tapers away from the column.
a.gu: Column થી દૂર depth taper થાય તેવું footing.

q.gu: Footing bending ક્યાં તપાસાય?

a.en: At the column face in both directions.

q.gu: Punching shear ક્યાં તપાસાય?

a.en: At the applicable perimeter d/2 from the column face.
a.gu: Column face થી d/2 દૂર લાગુ perimeter પર.

q.en: Why distinguish gross and net soil pressure?
q.gu: Gross અને net soil pressure વચ્ચે ભેદ કેમ કરવો?

a.en: To avoid inconsistent allowance for footing and overburden.
a.gu: Footing અને overburden નો અસંગત હિસાબ ટાળવા.
